items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: Have you seen reviews that aren’t as kind?

I’ve seen a couple. One of the very first travel gigs that I ever did, I was brand new. I did a festival in Clearwater, Florida. And I was a feature. I was a quick feature in the band and it was probably like a quartet. You know, rhythm section with a saxophone and a vibraphone, and I was part of it. And I was referred to as something like a “poor man’s Eddie Jefferson” or something like that. But you know what? I mean there are a lot of artists that I have heard say well I pay no attention to the reviews. It’s…
